command: nft add chain inet filter input_policy
nft add chain inet filter input_policy
nft add rule inet filter input_policy ct state established,related accept
nft add rule inet filter input_policy iif "lo" accept
nft add rule inet filter input_policy icmp type { echo-request, echo-reply, destination-unreachable, time-exceeded } accept
nft add rule inet filter input_policy proto tcp dport 2222 accept
nft add rule inet filter input_policy tcp dport 2222 accept
nft add rule inet filter input_policy udp dport 5555 accept
nft add rule inet filter input_policy log prefix "FW_INPUT_DROP" drop
nft add rule inet filter input position 0 jump input_policy
